verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so user-defined event-triggered rules are a fair axis, but the evidence never shows a rule engine or event triggers. The founder's note that it auto-categorizes describes built-in behavior, not rules users define. The MCP capabilities (labels, bulk archive/delete, send) are on-demand actions, not automatic event-driven ones.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
